description:
Every execution-config parameter a strategy can carry: the platform default, what it does, the effect of raising or lowering it, its legal bounds, and whether it is a strategy-character knob, an account guardrail, gated behind another flag, or retained but unused. Call it before discussing or overriding any risk parameter, so you describe the knob that exists rather than one you remember.

[Access: pay 0.001 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
